items.title: verify: a newer-schema export-entry.json in a selection package reports FAIL, not verifier-too-old
items.summary:
`validateExportEntry` strict-parses `export-entry.json`, so a selection package whose export entry comes from a newer manifest schema reports FAIL (exit 1) instead of the verifier-too-old outcome PR #1170 gives the manifest chain. The X25 principle - a newer schema is never reported as tamper - stops at the chain today and does not cover this package artifact.

items.summary:

